menu_options.tcp: Network gateway (RS485 to Ethernet, Modbus TCP)

tcp.title: TCP connection (RS485-Ethernet gateway)
tcp.description: Enter the IP address and port of the RS485-Ethernet gateway (e.g. Waveshare RS485 TO ETH in "Modbus TCP to RTU" mode, usually port 502).

serial.title: Serial connection (USB-RS485)
serial.description: Connect the USB-RS485 adapter to the VMC board and enter the connection parameters (factory defaults: 9600 baud, parity N, 1 stop bit, address 1).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the VMC board. Check the address/port (or the serial port and RS-485 wiring) and the communication parameters.

abort.already_configured: This VMC unit is already configured.
